dates.title: The program rule is published
dates.text: 32 CFR part 170, the CMMC Program rule, appears in the Federal Register.

citations.quote: 89 FR 83214, Oct. 15, 2024, unless otherwise noted.

dates.title: 32 CFR part 170 takes effect
dates.text: The program rule is in force from this day, with its requirements for defense contractors and subcontractors.

citations.quote: This rule is effective December 16, 2024.

This part describes the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Program of the Department of Defense (DoD) and establishes requirements for defense contractors and subcontractors to implement prescribed cybersecurity standards for safeguarding Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI).

dates.title: The clause takes effect; Phase 1 begins
dates.text: Awards can require Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self); DoD may ask for Level 2 (C3PAO) instead.

citations.quote: This rule is effective November 10, 2025.
The Effective Date for the Final CMMC DFARS Clause is 10 Nov 2025
Phase 1 – Initial Implementation · Begins 10 Nov 2025 · Where applicable, solicitations will require Level 1 or 2 self-assessment

Phase 1. Begins on the effective date of the complementary 48 CFR part 204 CMMC Acquisition final rule. DoD intends to include the requirement for CMMC Statuses of Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) for all applicable DoD solicitations and contracts as a condition of contract award. DoD may, at its discretion, include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) for applicable DoD solicitations and contracts as a condition to exercise an option period on a contract awarded prior to the effective date. DoD may also, at its discretion, include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) in place of the Level 2 (Self) CMMC Status for applicable DoD solicitations and contracts.

dates.title: Phase 2 is put on hold
dates.text: DoD, now also called the Department of War, suspended the move to Phase 2 while it reviews the program. Solicitations can require Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self); contracting officers are to remove or revise CMMC requirements in solicitations and contracts to match.

citations.quote: The DoW has suspended the transition to Phase 2 of the program.
The first phase of CMMC implementation began on November 10, 2025 and the DoW has suspended implementation in this phase in order to conduct a review of the program.

citations.where: Document Revision History, version 2.4, 7/13/2026, printed page 13 (PDF page 17)
citations.quote: Updated to reflect the suspension of the program in Phase 1 of implementation.

Collaborate with requiring activities to remove or revise the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements in new and existing solicitations and contracts in accordance with the Department of War Chief Information Officer’s memorandum, Suspension of the Advancement to Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Phase 2 Requirements, dated July 13, 2026
Permits requiring activities to include CMMC Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) assessments in all procurement requests and requirement documents
Suspends the November 2026 CMMC Phase 2 transition

dates.title: Phase 2 was to begin
dates.text: Under the rule’s original schedule, Level 2 (C3PAO) would become a condition of award, or wait for an option period, and DoD could ask for Level 3 (DIBCAC).

citations.quote: Phase 2 · Begins 10 Nov 2026 · Where applicable, solicitations will require Level 2 Certification · DoW may opt to delay the Level 2 certification requirement in a contract to an option period

Phase 2. Begins one calendar year following the start date of Phase 1. In addition to Phase 1 requirements, DoD intends to include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) for applicable DoD solicitations and contracts as a condition of contract award. DoD may, at its discretion, delay the inclusion of requirement for CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) to an option period instead of as a condition of contract award. DoD may also, at its discretion, include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 3 (DIBCAC) for applicable DoD solicitations and contracts.

dates.title: Phase 3 was to begin
dates.text: Under the rule’s original schedule: Level 2 (C3PAO) for every applicable award, and for option periods on contracts awarded since the clause took effect; Level 3 (DIBCAC) as a condition of award.

citations.quote: Phase 3 · Begins 10 Nov 2027 · Where applicable solicitations will require Level 3 Certification · DoW may opt to delay the Level 3 certification requirement in a contract to an option period

Phase 3. Begins one calendar year following the start date of Phase 2. In addition to Phase 1 and 2 requirements, DoD intends to include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) for all applicable DoD solicitations and contracts as a condition of contract award and as a condition to exercise an option period on a contract awarded after the effective date. DoD intends to include the requirement for CMMC Status of Level 3 (DIBCAC) for all applicable DoD solicitations and contracts as a condition of contract award. DoD may, at its discretion, delay the inclusion of requirement for CMMC Status of Level 3 (DIBCAC) to an option period instead of as a condition of contract award.

dates.title: Phase 4, full implementation, was to begin
dates.text: Under the rule’s original schedule, every applicable solicitation and contract would carry its CMMC requirement, including option periods on contracts awarded before then.

citations.quote: Phase 4 – Full Implementation · Begins 10 Nov 2028 · All solicitations and contracts will include applicable CMMC Level requirements as a condition of contract award

Phase 4, full implementation. Begins one calendar year following the start date of Phase 3. DoD will include CMMC Program requirements in all applicable DoD solicitations and contracts including option periods on contracts awarded prior to the beginning of Phase 4.
Not older than 1 year for Final Level 1 (Self)
the OSA must conduct a Level 1 self-assessment on an annual basis and submit the results in SPRS

durations.text: Repeated every three years, within three years of the status date.

citations.quote: Not older than 3 years for Final Level 2 (Self) assessments and Final Level 2 (C3PAO) assessments
the OSA must conduct a Level 2 self-assessment every three years and submit the results in SPRS, within three years of the CMMC Status Date associated with the Conditional Level 2 (Self).

durations.text: Repeated within three years of the status date.

citations.quote: Not older than 3 years for Final Level 2 (Self) assessments and Final Level 2 (C3PAO) assessments

To maintain compliance with the requirements for a CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO), the Level 2 certification assessment must be completed within three years of the CMMC Status Date associated with the Conditional Level 2 (C3PAO).

durations.text: Every three years, and the Level 2 (C3PAO) assessment under it too.

citations.quote: Not older than 3 years for Final Level 3 (DIBCAC) assessments

the Level 3 certification assessment must be performed every three years for all information systems within the Level 3 CMMC Assessment Scope. In addition, given that compliance with Level 2 requirements is a prerequisite for applying for CMMC Level 3, a Level 2 (C3PAO) certification assessment must also be conducted every three years to maintain CMMC Level 3 (DIBCAC) status.

durations.text: Expires unless the plan of action is closed out within 180 days of the status date.

citations.quote: Not older than 180 days for Conditional Level 2 (Self) assessments and Conditional Level 2 (certified third-party assessment organization (C3PAO)) assessments
Not older than 180 days for Conditional Level 3 (Defense Industrial Base Cybersecurity Assessment Center (DIBCAC)) assessments

The closing of a POA&M must be confirmed by a POA&M closeout assessment within 180-days of the Conditional CMMC Status Date. If the POA&M is not successfully closed out within the 180-day timeframe, the Conditional CMMC Status for the information system will expire.

durations.text: After every assessment, and every year after.

citations.quote: With regard to affirmation of continuous compliance (32 CFR 170.22), not older than 1 year with no changes in compliance with the requirements at 32 CFR part 170.
must affirm the continuing compliance of their respective organizations with the specified security requirement after every assessment, including POA&M closeout, and annually thereafter

rev3.title: When Rev 3 enters CMMC
rev3.text: Neither source gives a date: DoD says Revision 3 will come in through future rulemaking, and that assessments stay against Revision 2 under a class deviation until then.

citations.quote: Yes, the Department will incorporate Revision 3 with future rulemaking. In the interim, the Department has issued a class deviation to Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement clause 252.204-7012 to maintain Revision 2 as the standard against which defense industrial base companies will be assessed until Revision 3 has been incorporated into the 32 Code of Federal Regulations CMMC Program rule through rulemaking.
DoD will formally adopt Rev. 3 through future rulemaking.
DFARS 7012 Class Deviation: Assessments remain against Rev. 2 until Rev. 3 is officially adopted.
